command: pwsh -NoProfile -Command $p = Get-Process -Id 57888 -ErrorAction Stop; if ($p.Path -ne 'C:\Users\PC\AppData\Local\Cockpit Tools\cockpit-tools.exe') { throw 'Unexpected cockpit identity' }; $v = [ordered]@{ at=[DateTime]::UtcNow.ToString('o'); processId=$p.Id; executable=$p.Path; userAuthorizedTemporaryClose=$true }; $v | ConvertTo-Json | Set-Content -LiteralPath 'quality/evidence/T30/cockpit-temporary-close10.json' -Encoding utf8NoBOM; Stop-Process -Id $p.Id -ErrorAction Stop; $p.WaitForExit(); if (Get-Process -Id 57888 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { throw 'Cockpit close not confirmed' }; Write-Output 'Exact authorized Cockpit process closed.'
